nodes.label: Webapp guide and historical observations
nodes.rationale: Earlier feature and deployment observations belong to their recorded versions; the root checkpoint describes the current feature clusters.

nodes.label: Browser UI and routing
nodes.rationale: Browser lifecycle guards retain current route, session and request ownership; they do not prove native framework equivalence.

nodes.label: Same-origin private API
nodes.rationale: The server exposes a fixed public allowlist and private API routes rather than arbitrary file or URL access.

nodes.label: Origin-bound in-memory sessions
nodes.rationale: Exact Host and Origin checks, host-only cookies and CSRF protect account state kept in server memory.

nodes.label: Hash-pinned private runtime configuration
nodes.rationale: A source clone omits original ELF/pool artifacts and cannot establish live upstream configuration without separately provisioned evidence.

nodes.label: Verified bounded TLS transport
nodes.rationale: APK identity and trust are scoped to audited hosts; certificate and hostname verification remain enabled and credentials are excluded from logs.

nodes.label: Explicit validated operation catalog
nodes.rationale: Enabled operation schemas and the 176-record catalog do not measure completed features or production acceptance.

nodes.label: Explicit write and request ownership
nodes.rationale: Pre-dispatch failure and uncertain post-handoff delivery stay distinct; explicit user action and current-owner guards avoid unintentional replay.

nodes.label: BERKAS collection bookmark
nodes.rationale: The backend derives NIK from stored sign-in identity; initial message and save data have distinct native envelope semantics.

nodes.label: Wired PERSIL collection workflow
nodes.rationale: Original server context supplies the parcel ID; the browser does not invent it from a Berkas number. This supersedes the staged-only checkpoint.

nodes.label: Collection-specific cache effects
nodes.rationale: Group and item mutations have separate cache effects; local clone behavior does not establish server membership or cascade semantics.

nodes.label: Activity local deletion behavior
nodes.rationale: Local post-await disappearance remains distinct from confirmed server deletion and uses a separately scoped response parser.

nodes.label: Full Berkas journey destination
nodes.rationale: The dedicated Journey is wired; Tanya Berkas, sharing/download and selected inline geometry remain incomplete.

nodes.label: Personal Swaplotting submission
nodes.rationale: Personal plotting binds retained photo bytes and explicit submit to server-owned context; it does not waive visit checks or establish delegated instansi support.

nodes.label: Office QR guestbook submission
nodes.rationale: Nine raw fields become twelve ordered multipart parts using lookup-owned office/unit/user IDs and separate application authentication. Latest QA remains synthetic.

nodes.label: Queue review and notification gate
nodes.rationale: Final create remains gated without genuine browser notification provisioning; no invented FCM token or Android-key reuse.

nodes.label: Daring identity completion boundaries
nodes.rationale: Initial status/method and form exist; OTP, liveness, IKD and device-bound completion remain explicit limits.

nodes.label: Authoritative cross-tab session sync
nodes.rationale: Cross-tab notices are opaque and contain no credentials. Old responses cannot clear newer sessions and requests are not replayed automatically.

nodes.label: OpenStreetMap and Bhumi map
nodes.rationale: The reference pin and rendered geometry are not a survey boundary or accuracy certificate.

nodes.label: Real measurement coordinate tools
nodes.rationale: Imported or supplied coordinates enable local comparison and do not replace evidence of physical attendance.

nodes.label: Geotag upload remains disabled
nodes.rationale: The checkpoint does not implement visit bypass, fabricated positioning or remote attestation.

citations.quote: … `coordinate-comparison.js` computes local comparisons. These local tools do not replace evidence of physical attendance. Geotag upload remains disabled/official-app-required, and this checkpoint does not implement a visit bypass, fabricated positioning or remote attestation.
citations.section: Map and coordinate paths

nodes.label: Source-only publication boundary
nodes.rationale: Raw artifacts, local runtime evidence, credentials and tool environments are omitted; historical audit links can refer to unpublished local evidence.

nodes.label: Bounded production architecture graph
nodes.rationale: The graph excludes analysis history, tests/fixtures, generated JSON, vendored bundles and artwork while preserving published test source separately.

nodes.label: Full local native-evidence suite
nodes.rationale: The 2,520-test result belongs to the original analysis workspace with private/historical dependencies, not the source-only clone.

nodes.label: Synthetic Buku Tamu browser evidence
nodes.rationale: Fourteen browser checks including eleven DOM groups and 156 observations use injected accounts, QR, identity and transport; they do not submit to BPN.

nodes.label: Portable clone test result
nodes.rationale: 2,488 passed with no failures; 32 callbacks are explicitly omitted rather than counted as successful tests.

nodes.label: Explicit portable test exclusions
nodes.rationale: Two module-level exclusions omit thirteen callbacks and exact filters omit nineteen more, including mixed implementation/evidence assertions.

nodes.label: Read-only loopback Docker runtime
nodes.rationale: Loopback publication, read-only mounts/filesystem, dropped capabilities and no-new-privileges bound local service exposure.

nodes.label: Explicit Cloudflare public origin
nodes.rationale: The exact configured Host selects the accepted origin; forwarded headers confer no trust and public/local sessions are separate.

nodes.label: Read-only private artifact mounts
nodes.rationale: Only named original artifacts are mounted read-only; a public source clone omits them and cannot recreate upstream configuration by itself.

nodes.label: Session-bound document downloads
nodes.rationale: PDF shape/size and session expiry checks do not verify signatures, document authenticity or production acceptance.

nodes.label: Journey HH:mm formatter provenance
nodes.rationale: Dart SDK 3.12.2 and intl 0.20.2 reference with retained dependency licenses; exact APK intl release/equivalence remains unproved.

nodes.label: Certificate date formatter provenance
nodes.rationale: Dart SDK 3.12.2 and intl 0.20.2 reference with retained dependency licenses; exact APK intl release/equivalence remains unproved.
